name: prodigi-mcp
description: Prodigi (ecommerce suppliers): me, get_product, create_order, get_order. Every tool maps to a docume

platform_mcp_prodigi_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PRODIGI_API_KEY
platform_mcp_prodigi_api_key.description: Prodigi API key for the LIVE environment (dashboard), sent as `X-API-Key`. A Sandbox key needs PLATFORM_MCP_PRODIGI_ENV=sandbox (https://api.sandbox.prodigi.com/v4.0).

platform_mcp_prodigi_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PRODIGI_ENV
platform_mcp_prodigi_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://api.sandbox.prodigi.com/v4.0. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_prodigi_base_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PRODIGI_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_prodigi_base_url.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Prodigi has no account endpoint; the probe lists one order (GET /v4.0/Orders?top=1).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: `id` is the Prodigi SKU (e.g. GLOBAL-CAN-10X10); productDimensions, attributes, printAreas and variants[] are in `raw`. Prices come from POST /quotes, not from the product.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Spends money on the live account. `shipping_address` is Prodigi's recipient {name, email, phoneNumber, address{line1, line2, postalOrZipCode, countryCode, townOrCity, stateOrCounty}}; `items` are Prodigi items [{sku, copies, sizing, attributes, assets[{printArea, url}]}]; `shipping_option` is the required shippingMethod (Budget|Standard|Express|Overnight).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: status.stage is one of the order stages (InProgress, Complete, ...); charges[] and shipments[{carrier, tracking{number, url}}] are in `raw`.
